notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for receive-order interaction callback cancellation. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies ordinary interaction publication, subscription, queued send, active-subscription withdrawal before callback servicing, callback-model boundaries, and standard federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador ordinary interaction publication, send, and subscription withdrawal with FederateAmbassador receive-order interaction callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador interaction declaration and FederateAmbassador delivery declarations
